Arm. You have an additional arm somewhere on your body. The additional arm can manipulate an object, open or close a door or container, pick up or set down a Tiny object, or wield a weapon that has the light property. This does not give you additional attacks, but does give you a +2 bonus on ability checks to grapple a creature.
Leg. You have an additional leg somewhere on your body. This leg gives you a +2 bonus on ability checks and saving throws against being knocked prone or moved against your will. Your walking speed increases by 5 ft per additional leg you have when you take the dash action.
You can take this attribute multiple times, up to a total of four times.
